title: HOT WHEELS Infinite Rush
summary: HOT WHEELS Infinite Rush is Milestone's racing game, released on Switch 2 on September 10, 2026. At 12.7 GB it is a modest install, but the boxed version is a Game-Key Card: the cartridge only unlocks the download, so you need an internet connection the first time. According to the figures reported by GamingBolt, the Switch 2 version targets 1080p at 30 FPS, half the frame rate of the PS5 and Xbox Series X versions, which run at 4K and 60 FPS. On the plus side it supports four players on one system and up to 12 online, which makes it a reasonable couch racer if 30 FPS doesn't bother you.

performance.note: Target figures reported by GamingBolt; PS5 and Xbox Series X run at 4K and 60 FPS.
